How the building permit fee is calculated
1. Base fee by project type: new detached house NZD 250.00; house extension NZD 150.00; garage NZD 400.00; loft conversion NZD 600.00; commercial fit-out NZD 250.00; conservatory NZD 400.00.
2. Floor-area fee: the first 80 m2 at NZD 4.78 per m2, the next 100 m2 at NZD 7.04 per m2, and every m2 above 180 m2 at NZD 7.10 per m2 (each band is charged only for the area inside it).
3. Plan review: 15 % of the base fee plus the floor-area fee.
4. Heritage zone: a flat NZD 120.00 for sites in a heritage zone.
5. Expedited processing (on request): 50 % added to the total of all fees above.
6. Minimum: the total permit fee is at least NZD 3,390.00.
The total is rounded to cents at the end.
